clue.text: Stylish students close to mutiny

parts.note: a class is a group of students taught together

indicators.note: close to means the closing letter of the word mutiny is taken

explanation.surface: Fashionable students are on the verge of rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone classy shows elegance and good taste.

clue.text: Dishonourable guy imbibing aloes, upset, all doctor has to deal with?

definitions.text: all doctor has to deal with

indicators.note: imbibing means the cad drinks in, enclosing, the other letters

parts.note: a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably

indicators.note: upset means the letters of aloes are jumbled

explanation.surface: A rogue drinking aloes and getting sick, all a GP must handle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' is the anagram signal, giving SELOA; the question mark marks the definition as a playful description rather than a dictionary sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Total of cases or patients a professional such as a doctor must handle at one time.

clue.text: Prickly shrub cut and turned up, move quickly to change photo?

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the shortened letters are read upwards, reversed
cut means the shrub word loses its last letter

parts.note: a briar is a thorny shrub
to rush is to move fast

explanation.surface: Trim and flip a thorny plant, then hurry to retouch a picture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut' trims BRIAR to BRIA, and 'turned up' reverses that to AIRB.
explanation.definitionFit: Verb: to retouch or alter a photograph, originally using a fine spray of paint.

clue.text: Small monitoring device for men only

parts.note: a tag is an electronic device used to track someone

explanation.surface: A tiny tracking gadget meant just for blokes.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective as in a party attended solely by males.

clue.text: After fuss, rule skilfully in way inspiring great affection

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother, as in Much Ado About Nothing
ably means competently or skilfully

explanation.surface: After some commotion, a leader governs expertly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After' just tells you the fuss comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An adverb describing behaviour so charming that it makes people love you dearly.

clue.text: Wild parties with blue displays at the start, not proper or decent!

indicators.note: at the start means the opening letter of displays is taken
wild means the letters of parties and blue are rearranged chaotically

explanation.surface: Raucous parties with smutty shows at first, utterly indecent!
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: having a bad reputation, not respectable.

clue.text: Almost prepared to study

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: ready means prepared

explanation.surface: Nearly prepared to sit down and do some revision.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to study a subject, as at university.

clue.text: No rank and file mover on board

definitions.text: No rank and file mover on board

parts.words: No rank and file mover on board
parts.note: on a chessboard ranks are rows and files columns; this piece moves only diagonally, never along them

explanation.surface: Someone senior on the board isn't one of the ordinary workers.
explanation.definitionFit: The chess piece that moves diagonally, never along ranks or files.

clue.text: Over there see surprise when leader's replaced by unknown

indicators.note: says the first letter of the surprise word is swapped for the unknown letter

parts.note: wonder is a feeling of amazement or surprise
in algebra y is an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: Look over there for a surprise when the boss is swapped for a stranger.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic or poetic word for something at a distance, within sight.

clue.text: It's irresistibly funny from Sweden, the very best!

parts.note: S is the international vehicle registration letter for Sweden
the cream is the very best part, as in the cream of the crop

explanation.surface: A hilarious comedy import from Sweden is top quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially, a thing or person that is hilarious is called a scream.

clue.text: He may take a VIP out

definitions.text: He may take a VIP out

parts.words: He may take a VIP out
parts.note: take out is slang for kill, and a killer of a prominent figure has a specific name

explanation.surface: A man might escort an important guest out for the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: A killer who murders a political or public figure is described by this term.

clue.text: Poorly? Airmail natal drug

indicators.note: poorly means the letters of Airmail natal are rearranged as if unwell

explanation.surface: Feeling ill? A medicine is sent by air.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a medicine taken to prevent or treat malaria.

clue.text: Numerologist brings back traditional knowledge

indicators.note: back means the run found in Numerologist is read in reverse order
the word Numerologist brings within it a run of letters inside its spelling

explanation.surface: A numbers mystic passes down age-old wisdom.
explanation.walkthrough: The run EROL inside numEROLogist, turned round by 'back', gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: body of traditions and beliefs handed down within a group or culture.

clue.text: Great annoyance when fisherman drops line

indicators.note: drops means the letter for line is left out of the fisherman word

parts.note: an angler is someone who fishes with rod and line

explanation.surface: An angler is irritated after losing his fishing line.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: strong displeasure or wrath is a great annoyance.

clue.text: Father with English church leader in Rome

parts.note: pop is an informal word for a father

explanation.surface: A priest and an Englishman meet a senior cleric in Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bishop of Rome heads the Roman Catholic Church.

clue.text: Intended average over time

parts.note: the mean is an average

explanation.surface: Planned middle figure across a period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over' in a down clue puts the average above the time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: purposed or planned.

clue.text: Flat area lacking special beauty

explanation.definitionFit: The noun names level grassland; the adjective describes homely looks.

clue.text: It could make beauty lissom? Living like this might help

indicators.note: could make means the letters of beauty lissom can be rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: A slimming tip: strict self-denial might help you become a lithe beauty.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram is signalled by 'could make'; the second sentence defines the manner of living.
explanation.definitionFit: Living with restraint in eating and drinking is the manner this adverb describes.

clue.text: Noble from Belgium with reasons to change

parts.note: B is the international vehicle registration letter for Belgium

indicators.note: to change means the letters of reasons are rearranged

explanation.surface: An aristocrat from Brussels has reasons to alter things.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a woman holding a rank of the peerage.

clue.text: That lady's taken up organ with singular energy, take steps beforehand!

indicators.note: taken up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, reversed

parts.note: her refers to that lady
the ear is the organ of hearing
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: She has lifted her musical instrument with real energy to practise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organ' suggests a musical instrument but it is the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: practise in advance before a performance.

clue.text: Disable IT at an ice cap possibly?

indicators.note: possibly means the letters of IT at an ice cap may be shuffled into another form

explanation.surface: Would freezing polar conditions knock out the computer systems?
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to make someone or something unable to function normally.

clue.text: Some of China's lanterns at a slope

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Several of the Chinese lanterns are hanging crooked.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: tilted, at an angle.

clue.text: Hasty about turning over meat

parts.note: rash means hasty or reckless

indicators.note: turning over means the word for about is reversed

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A hurried cook flips the bacon.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a thin slice of bacon or ham.

clue.text: Friend's coming over for make-up

indicators.note: coming over means the letters are flipped round, read from the back

parts.note: pal is a friend; with the 's it gives pals

explanation.surface: A friend visits to borrow cosmetics.
explanation.definitionFit: Slap is informal theatrical slang for cosmetics or greasepaint.

clue.text: Bill with the French item of furniture

parts.note: a tab is a bill, as in picking up the tab
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A bill arrives for a piece of French furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a flat-topped piece of furniture on legs, used for eating or working.

clue.text: National from east (or north or eouth?)

definitions.meaning: a citizen of Poland, a country of eastern Europe
the earth's two extreme points, north and south, are each this

explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'eouth' is a typing slip for 'south'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a native of Poland and either end of the earth's axis share this word.

clue.text: Cloth examined by touch

definitions.meaning: past tense of a verb for touching to explore

explanation.definitionFit: A pressed woollen fabric, and the past tense of touching to explore.

clue.text: Willing to try football, perhaps

definitions.meaning: a sport or match, of which football is one example

explanation.definitionFit: Adjective for being up for anything; noun for a sport such as football.

clue.text: Physically fit husband's outward signs of love in upper room?

indicators.note: in means the husband and love letters go inside the room

parts.note: an attic is a room at the top of a house
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

indicators.note: outward signs means the outer letters of love are used

explanation.surface: A fit husband shows his affection in the loft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outward signs of' love are its outer letters, L and E, which follow H inside ATTIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: strong, muscular and in good physical condition.

clue.text: Move swiftly like someone in profession

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, describing someone pursuing a lifelong occupation, as in a lifelong diplomat

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to hurtle along; the adjective describes a professional, lifelong pursuit.

clue.text: Engine feature that might be hotter, left at the margins

indicators.note: might be means the letters can be rearranged to form something new
the margins of the word left are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A part of the motor could overheat, it is stated, at the edges.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At the margins' gives LT, the outer letters of 'left', which join HOTTER as anagram fodder for 'might be'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the valve controlling fuel flow to an engine and so its speed.

clue.text: Tenant maybe not so keen at heart

parts.note: less means not so much, to a smaller degree

indicators.note: at heart means the central letters of keen are used

explanation.surface: Perhaps a renter who is not very enthusiastic.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who holds a property under a lease.
